description.value: Papa John's is a national pizza chain operating a delivery and carryout location on Kingsway in Vancouver's East Side. The store focuses on pizza, breadsticks, and wings for takeout or delivery, with no dine-in component. Cyclists passing through the area can pick up a carryout order without a sit-down stop.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 40m; stands (2 spaces) at 55m; stands (2 spaces) at 74m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 81m; stands (2 spaces) at 83m; stands (2 spaces) at 93m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Papa John's carryout/delivery location at #300-3320 Kingsway, Vancouver BC V5R 5L1, with phone (604) 437-1717 matching OSM. The OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's explicit 'Order Carryout' option. Neither the website nor OSM tags contain any evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: Delivery/carryout-only chain with no dine-in area — customer washroom availability is unconfirmed.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, water refill, Wi-Fi) confirmed from website or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a chain fast-food pizza delivery/carryout outlet with no confirmed cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi).
